Aisha Patel: Heads-up — Aurora Media just flipped on a bunch of Creator Platform workloads across multiple squads (Creator Tools, Content QA, Monetization). We're seeing new use cases: in-editor summarization, real-time personalization, and live creator insights. This looks like a multi-team expansion signal.

Tom Rivera: Do we have rough numbers on the spike?

Aisha Patel: Quick telemetry snapshot: 24h rolling avg reqs up ~4x vs baseline; peak token throughput ~1.2M tokens/hour. Embedding calls up ~6x. They requested ~200 concurrent live sessions for analytics. They asked about Dedicated and a VPC option for isolation.

Maya Chen: @Aisha can you confirm the customer contact + renewal date? Any blockers today for offering Dedicated?

Aisha Patel: Contact is Evan Li (Aurora Media). Renewal window: Oct 2025. Current contract covers hosted only. Blockers they've mentioned: EU-region egress latency, want burst capacity guarantees, and they want a short enablement runbook + workshop for their dev squads. They also reported intermittent overnight throttling spikes.

Tom Rivera: :eyes: Sounds like a clear expansion opportunity. Proposed actions: 1) draft Dedicated pilot + estimated cost delta; 2) schedule a 2-hour enablement workshop (Solutions + SE); 3) infra to validate EU routing/latency and suggest routing policy; 4) product/optimize to propose batching/KV caching tweaks and quantization guidance for embeddings.

Maya Chen: I'll own workshop scheduling. @InfraBot can you run a quick capacity check for sustained 1.2M tokens/hr and ~200 concurrent sessions and recommend GPU footprint?

InfraBot: Capacity check queued. Quick estimate (very rough): sustained workload with KV cache enabled suggests ~2x p4d-24x equivalent for throughput; recommend Dedicated min 4 GPU nodes for headroom during bursts. Will post a detailed breakdown to #eng-infra in ~2h.

Aisha Patel: Also capturing feedback from Evan: they'd like finer cost breakdown by workspace and by internal team, plus better per-route latency reporting for EU. Added note: they collected short prompt sets for regression tests — will share after workshop.

Tom Rivera: Risk callout: if we don't move fast on a pilot or if we miss low-latency SLOs before the renewal conversation, they may evaluate alternatives. Prioritize workshop + pilot quote this week. @Maya @Aisha confirm availability.

Maya Chen: Confirmed. I'll propose Tue/Thu next week windows and collect the prompt sets and sample traces from their teams for evals.

Aisha Patel: Marked in CRM as "High expansion" and flagged for AE outreach. I'll prepare an internal playbook (objectives, success metrics, escalation path) after the workshop. :rocket:

Tom Rivera: Great. I'll start a price/technical brief for the pilot and loop in Product for optimization recommendations.

InfraBot: Follow-up will include estimated GPU-hours, recommended autoscale policy, and suggested burst capacity options.

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — I'll update once Evan confirms workshop slot.
